 Job Description 
 Responsible for handling outbound domestic and international shipping including packing and labeling shipments. Involves comprehensive management of export trade compliance duties for the company and requires familiarity with local and international Government regulations. Primary responsibility is to ensure the highest level of quality order fulfillment through order receipt to product delivery of Thermo Fisher products. 
 Location: 
 This position is based in Milton, Ontario, Canada, at Thermo Fisher Scientific’s facility located at 95 Market Drive — a logistics and export operations site where outbound domestic and international shipping and trade compliance activities are performed.   
 Training will be conducted at the Mississauga Site - 2100 Syntex Court for 3 to 6 months. 
 Essential Functions:  
 ·       Prepare and process required export documentation including but not limited to commercial invoices, export declaration, certificates of origin and/or CUSMA, bills of lading, and advanced ship notices.  
 ·       Resolve the eligibility of various Free Trade Agreements.  
 ·       Organize and follow up with internal/external customers.  
 ·       Co-ordinate releases with QA for shipments.  
 ·       Update SAP for billing purposes and scanning.  
 ·       Wrap, tape, and prepare small shipments.  
 ·       Monitor, maintain and operate CBSA websites and tools (i.e. CERS, HS Tariff Schedule, etc.)  
 ·       Actively participate in (CBSA) Customs, and internal Audits and other major projects as required 
 ·       Act as the Export Coordinator for trade compliance activities.  
 ·       Conduct restricted party screening of business partners.  
 ·       Review and follow the requirements of the Company's Global Trade Compliance Policy and the Global Trade Compliance Management System.  
 ·       Maintain a safe working environment and reports potential hazards.
 ·       Perform alternating or rotating shift work as required.
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 
 Education: 
 ·       High school diploma or equivalent required.
 Experience: 
 Minimum 1 year of experience in export regulations, documentation, and compliance standards.
 ·       Experience filing Canada Export Reports using CBSA websites
 ·       SAP experience in the sales & distribution, planning and shipment module, preferred
 Equivalency : 
 Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant work experience may be considered.
 Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 
 ·       Familiarity with the Canada Customs Tariff and possess extensive knowledge of HTS classification.
 Highly organized and able to undertake and prioritize a multitude of tasks in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong attention to detail, highly efficient and effective time management skills.
 Work efficiently with limited supervision. 
 Strong oral and written communication skills. 
 Dedicated to achieving outcomes.
 Strong interpersonal skills.
 Proven computer proficiency with Microsoft Office programs. 
 Proficiency with the English Language.
 Standards and Expectations:    
 Follow all Environmental Health & Safety Policies and Procedures. Work collaboratively with fellow team members, modelling positive team principles and partnering to meet project and departmental objectives. Perform all duties within strict compliance with Patheon quality systems Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP). Maintain the workspace in a clean and orderly fashion.  Effectively engage in and adhere to departmental systems to maintain a smooth and efficient workflow (visual management, scheduling systems, etc.). Always be client and patient conscious. Understand Key Performance Indicators and strive to improve the performance of the team by identifying areas for system improvements and engage in problem solving. Model positive thinking and is open to change, motivating the team to adapt to shifts in priorities and new ways of working. Proactively identify areas for improvement in the execution of procedures. Communicate risks to timelines in an initiative-taking manner.  Consistently strives to improve skills and knowledge in related fields.    
 Physical Requirements: 
 Light physical effort and fatigue. Walks, sits, or stands for limited periods. May require occasional equipment operation including keyboard equipment. Lifts light items for limited duration. Typically located in a comfortable indoor area.  There may be exposure to mild physical discomfort from factors such as dust, fumes or odours, temperature extremes, loud noise, strong drafts, or bright lights. Use of Personal Protective equipment may be required and may include any of the following: safety glasses, safety shoes, lab coat, gloves, hair net, beard cover, safety apron, respirator occasionally.

The estimated annualized pay range for this position in Ontario is $41,900.00–$62,900.00.

Tutor Me Education is looking for an outstanding communicator and relationship manager to serve as the primary point of contact for families, students, and instructors in our Special Education Tutoring program. This role is about case management, not instruction — you'll be the calm, organized, professional voice that keeps families informed, schedules running smoothly, and everyone feeling taken care of. Strong candidates from customer service, account management, hospitality, or virtual operations backgrounds are encouraged to apply as long as they have some educational experience.
 What You'll Do 
 Serve as the primary relationship manager for a caseload of families — building trust, answering questions, and being their go-to contact
 Conduct intake calls with new families and set expectations clearly and confidently
 Build and manage class schedules across multiple students, teachers, and platforms
 Communicate proactively with families about scheduling, progress, and any concerns — via phone, video, and written correspondence
 Monitor student progress and flag concerns to the appropriate specialist
 Coordinate with instructors to ensure sessions run smoothly
 Navigate multiple software systems daily (scheduling platforms, spreadsheets, video conferencing, CRM/case management tools) without missing a beat
 Represent Tutor Me Education professionally in every interaction — you are often the face of the company to our families
 Support basic oversight of IEP/504 accommodation compliance (full training provided — deep SPED expertise not required)
 What We're Looking For (in priority order) 
 Outstanding communicator. You speak clearly, confidently, and warmly — on the phone, on video, and in writing. You can deliver hard news to a frustrated parent without sounding defensive, and you make people feel heard.
 Tech-comfortable and virtual-ready. You show up to virtual meetings with a working camera and headset, a quiet professional space, and you move between multiple platforms (spreadsheets, scheduling tools, video conferencing) without friction.
 A true professional who represents our brand well. You're organized, reliable, and composed under pressure. Families and school partners should always come away with a great impression of our company because of you.
 Special education experience strongly preferred. Direct experience with IEPs, 504 plans, or students with disabilities is a significant advantage and will be weighted favorably. Candidates with strong general education or tutoring experience — and exceptional performance on 1-3 above — will also be considered. All candidates should be ready to build fluency with IEP/504 basics, academic frameworks, and case management systems.
 Excellent verbal and written English communication skills — required, and heavily assessed in our interview process
 Reliable high-speed internet, a working webcam, and a headset/microphone for virtual meetings
 Comfortable learning and using multiple software platforms (Google Workspace/Microsoft Office required; scheduling and CRM tools trained on the job)
 Prior experience in a remote/virtual role strongly preferred
 Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities independently
 Customer service, account management, or client-facing experience preferred
 Bachelor's degree preferred, not required
 Some experience in an educational setting required (school, tutoring, or similar) — experience with special education, IEPs, or students with disabilities is strongly preferred
 Bilingual English/Spanish a plus
 Fully Remote!

JOB DESCRIPTION: 
 À propos d’Abbott 
 Abbott est un chef de file mondial de l’industrie des soins de santé qui crée des solutions scientifiques révolutionnaires visant à améliorer la santé des gens. L’entreprise est résolument tournée vers l’avenir, à l’affût des changements qui pourraient survenir dans le domaine des sciences et des technologies médicales.
 Être à l’emploi d’Abbott 
 En étant à l’emploi d’Abbott, vous pourrez faire un travail qui compte, vous perfectionner et apprendre, prendre soin de vous et des membres de votre famille, rester fidèle à ce que vous êtes et vivre pleinement. Vous pourrez :
 profiter de possibilités d’avancement professionnel au sein d’une entreprise internationale qui vous permettra de bâtir la carrière dont vous rêvez;
 travailler pour une entreprise reconnue dans des douzaines de pays partout dans le monde comme étant un excellent milieu de travail et figurant parmi les entreprises les plus admirées dans le monde dans le classement Fortune; 
 travailler pour une grande entreprise reconnue comme étant l’une des meilleures où travailler, notamment pour ce qui a trait à la diversité du personnel, à la conciliation travail-famille ainsi qu’à la place des femmes dans les postes de cadres et les postes scientifiques.
 L’occasion à saisir 
 La personne titulaire du poste travaillera à notre siège social à Montréal (Saint-Laurent), au sein du département corporatif des ressources humaines et nécessite une présence au bureau quatre jours par semaine , avec la possibilité de travailler à distance une journée.
 À titre de Coordonnateur(trice) ressources humaines , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'expérience employé et le soutien aux gestionnaires. Vous serez exposé(e) à l'ensemble des activités RH et participerez activement à des projets et initiatives ayant un impact direct sur nos employés et notre organisation.
 Votre rôle sera déterminant pour maintenir un environnement de travail sain et assurer le respect de l’ensemble des lois et règlements en matière de travail. Vous contribuerez à l’amélioration continue des conditions de travail, positionnant ainsi Abbott Canada comme un employeur de choix.
 Ce que vous ferez 
 Agir comme premier point de contact auprès des employés et des gestionnaires en répondant à leurs questions concernant les programmes, politiques et procédures RH et en les orientant vers les ressources appropriées au besoin.
 Participer activement à la gestion et à l'amélioration des communications RH, notamment par la mise à jour du portail « myHR », des articles de référence et des politiques internes afin d'offrir une expérience utilisateur optimale.
 Coordonner et faire évoluer les programmes de reconnaissance des employés, incluant les anniversaires de service, les récompenses et diverses initiatives favorisant l'engagement et la culture d'entreprise.
 Assurer le suivi des dossiers d'invalidité, des demandes d'accommodement et des retours au travail, en partenariat avec les gestionnaires, les employés et les différents intervenants.
 Maintenir l'intégrité des données dans le système d'information RH (SIRH), produire des rapports et analyses, et contribuer à la prise de décisions basée sur les données.
 Coordonner les activités d'accueil et d'intégration des nouveaux employés et travailler en collaboration avec les différents partenaires afin d'assurer une expérience d'intégration positive et efficace.
 Assurer la gestion administrative et financière de certains programmes RH, incluant le traitement, la validation et le suivi des factures liées aux avantages sociaux et autres initiatives RH et es processus de remboursement des frais de scolarité et de formation, incluant la Loi sur les compétences (Loi du 1 %) ainsi que les initiatives de conformité linguistique auprès de l'OQLF.
 Analyser des données RH, identifier les tendances et préparer des recommandations visant à améliorer l'expérience employé, l'engagement, l'attraction et la rétention des talents.
 Participer à la planification et à la coordination de projets RH et soutenir la mise en œuvre d'initiatives ayant un impact à l'échelle de l'organisation.
 Contribuer au maintien des plus hauts standards en matière de protection des renseignements personnels, de confidentialité et de gouvernance des données RH.
 Compétences requises 
 Baccalauréat en gestion des ressources humaines, en administration des affaires, en psychologie ou dans un domaine connexe.
 D’un à trois ans d’expérience dans un département des RH.
 Titre professionnel canadien en RH (CRHA/CHRL) obtenu ou en cours d’obtention souhaité.
 Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et en communication verbale et écrite.
 Fort sens de l’analyse et aptitudes démontrées à interpréter des données et en résolution de problème.
 Capacité à maintenir un haut niveau de confidentialité et à faire preuve de discrétion en tout temps.
 Maîtrise des logiciels de la suite MS Office, notamment PowerPoint, Word et Excel.
 Bonne connaissance des systèmes SIRH utilisés en entreprise.
 Bilinguisme (français et anglais), tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit. Le ou la titulaire du poste doit pouvoir bien communiquer en anglais (50% du temps), car ses fonctions exigent des interactions avec des intervenants et collègues se trouvant à l’extérieur du Québec ou du Canada.
 About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology. 
 Working at Abbott 
 At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:
 Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
 A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
 A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.
 The opportunity 
 The person int his role will work at our Montreal (Saint-Laurent ) head office as part of the Corporate Human Resources team and requires on‑site presence four days per week, with the option to work remotely one day.
 As an HR Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting both employees and managers while contributing to an exceptional employee experience. You will gain exposure to all aspects of Human Resources and actively participate in projects and initiatives that have a direct impact on our employees and organization.
 Your role will be instrumental in fostering a positive work environment and ensuring compliance with employment laws and regulations. You will contribute to the continuous improvement of working conditions, helping position Abbott Canada as an employer of choice.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Serve as the first point of contact for employees and managers, responding to inquiries related to HR programs, policies, and practices, and directing them to the appropriate resources as needed.
 Actively contribute to the management and enhancement of HR communications, including maintaining the “myHR” portal, knowledge articles, and internal policies to ensure an optimal user experience.
 Coordinate and continuously improve employee recognition programs, including service anniversaries, awards, and other engagement and culture-building initiatives.
 Support disability management, workplace accommodation requests, and return-to-work cases in partnership with managers, employees, and other stakeholders.
 Maintain the integrity of HR data within the Human Resources Information System (HRIS), generate reports and analyses, and support data-driven decision-making.
 Coordinate onboarding and orientation activities for new employees while partnering with key stakeholders to ensure a positive and effective onboarding experience.
 Administer and oversee various HR programs, including the processing, validation, and tracking of invoices related to employee benefits and other HR initiatives, as well as tuition reimbursement and training programs, compliance with Quebec's Training Law (1% Training Law), and language compliance initiatives with the OQLF.
 Analyze HR data, identify trends, and develop recommendations to enhance employee experience, engagement, talent attraction, and retention.
 Support the planning and coordination of HR projects and contribute to the implementation of organization-wide initiatives.
 Help maintain the highest standards of privacy, confidentiality, and HR data governance.
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
 One to three years of experience in a Human Resources role.
 CHRP/CRHA designation completed or in progress is considered an asset.
 Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and develop recommendations.
 Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
 Working knowledge of Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS).
 Bilingualism (French and English), both spoken and written. The incumbent must be able to communicate well in English (50% of the time), as his or her duties require interaction with stakeholders and colleagues outside Quebec or Canada.

N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

Travaillant au sein de la direction Gestion des risques, la personne titulaire du poste assure le pilotage de la fonction risque du Projet. 
Son mandat est transversal : elle orchestre l'ensemble des contributeurs à la gestion des risques — équipes internes multi-métiers, partenaires DPM et OPM, ainsi que l'équipe Gestion des risques — afin de produire une lecture consolidée, cohérente et exploitable des risques du programme. 
Elle encadre également une équipe interne de gestion des risques et pilote la relation avec les équipes externes mandatées en soutien à la fonction, tout en assurant l'interface quotidienne avec les nombreux utilisateurs et contributeurs du registre des risques à travers les disciplines et les entités du Projet. 
 Principales responsabilités 
 1. Leadership transversal et coordination interdisciplinaire 
 Piloter la coordination de la fonction Gestion des risques à travers l'ensemble des métiers et des entités du Projet : conception, exploitation, autorité, équipes externes.
 Assurer l'alignement méthodologique et la cohérence des livrables produits par les différentes équipes contribuant au registre des risques.
 Animer les interfaces interdisciplinaires (Conception, Systèmes, RAMS, SST, Cybersécurité, Environnement, Commercial, Approvisionnement) et arbitrer les zones grises entre les parties prenantes.

ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

Forward Deployed Engineering is Baseten’s swat team. We’re deeply technical, great with customers and fast, and we make the platform better with everything we learn in the field. FDEs take on the hardest inference problems for our most strategic customers: novel architectures, extreme scale, tight latency budgets. Then we turn those solutions into a platform no one can match.

We’re scaling the team quickly. We need someone to build the operating system that lets a fast-growing team of engineers stay focused on hard problems instead of coordination.

This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to our largest customers and to company leadership. You’ll shape how a new kind of engineering team operates in the AI industry.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Run the priority account cadence. Own the operating rhythm for our top accounts: daily hot-account check-ins, the weekly “forest view” review with leadership, and the account list itself with Sales leadership. Goal: zero surprise escalations to our execs.

 - Make the bridges work. Our FDE team connects to SA and Sales, Product, engineering (inference, infra), capacity and on-call. You’ll make sure each connection has a clear owner, cadence and SLA, with no hand-offs falling through the cracks:
   
   - Account transitions between solution architect and FDE, with exit criteria and runbooks
   
   - Non-P0 escalations to engineering teams, tracked and burned down weekly
   
   - Customer patterns and gaps flowing into the product roadmap

 - Drive cross-team programs for our largest customers. Coordinate multi-team efforts such as dedicated-capacity rollouts, cluster migrations, capacity reservations and large customer launches. Bring together various teams so these run on a plan, not on heroics.

 - Reduce toil and protect platform time. Track where engineering time goes: incidents another team owns, manual routing and config changes, after-hours pages. Work with engineering leads to remove the biggest sources of obstacles, so FDEs keep 30% of their time for shaping the platform.

 - Own the metrics. Build and report the metrics scorecard (account health, response times, toil, load per engineer, team health) to leadership.

 - Help us scale the team. Drive programs like new-hire enablement and certification, account load balancing, and run book coverage. Partner with Recruiting on hiring operations as we grow.

 - Manage risk and dependencies. Maintain a clear-eyed view of cross-team dependencies and risks; surface them early, drive mitigation, and keep leadership informed with honest, signal-rich updates.

 - Communicate up, down, and across. Translate between deeply technical teams and senior leadership. Run effective program reviews and write the kind of crisp statuses that let busy people make fast decisions.

REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years as a TPM (or engineer turned TPM) on infrastructure, cloud or customer-facing technical programs

 - Technical depth: you’re comfortable with ML Infra systems, Kubernetes, GPUs and distributed systems, and can follow an incident channel or a design doc without a translator. Experience with LLM inference is a strong plus.

 - You’ve run programs across many teams at once and kept them moving without formal authority

 - Calm in the middle of an escalation: you bring structure to chaos and close the loop

 - You write clearly and concisely, for engineers and for execs

 - High ownership, and you’d rather fix the process than work around it

NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience working on AI / ML Infra stack.

 - Background in solutions engineering, SRE or forward-deployed teams

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - In your first few months, you'll have taken ownership of one or more in-flight programs, established the operating rhythm they were missing, and built the trust that makes teams want you in the room.

 - Within a year, the programs you run are the ones leadership doesn't worry about, because the structure is clear, the risks are visible early, and the follow-ups always close.



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

 About this position: 
 We're hiring an AI Automation Engineer to embed across teams at Later, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and beyond, and replace manual, repetitive work with durable AI-powered tooling.
 This role sits at the intersection of engineer, internal consultant, and coach: you'll build the automations that move the needle today and level up non-technical colleagues to build the next wave themselves. This is a high-leverage role for someone who gets energy from solving real business problems, ships pragmatic v1s in days rather than months, and knows when a scrappy prototype needs to be hardened into something the whole org can rely on. You'll work across Later's lines of business (Later Influence, Later Social, and Later Creator), with regular exposure to senior leadership and broad visibility into how the company actually runs. 
 What you'll be doing: 
 Partnership & Discovery 
 Embed with non-technical stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and other functions to understand their workflows in depth.
 Surface the highest-impact automation opportunities and translate fuzzy, ambiguous problems into clear technical solutions.
 Leave every stakeholder conversation with a sharper problem definition than you walked in with. 
 Building & Shipping 
 Build automations and internal tools using AI-native platforms, scripting, APIs, and whatever else gets the job done, pragmatism over purity. 
 Ship working v1s quickly so stakeholders can validate value before investment scales.
 Wire together LLMs, agents, RAG patterns, and prompt design with existing systems to deliver real workflow outcomes. 
 Scaling & Reliability 
 Take working prototypes and harden them with the reliability, observability, error handling, and reusability needed for production use.
 Define when a one-off solution is good enough as-is versus when it needs to be promoted into something the whole org can rely on.
 Build the monitoring and documentation that lets automations run unattended and recover gracefully when they don't.
 Enablement & Coaching 
 Coach and advise non-technical colleagues who are building their own automations: review their work, unblock them, and level up their skills over time. 
 Run lightweight enablement (working sessions, office hours, shared documentation) that grows the citizen-developer community at Later.
 Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to non-technical audiences and teach others to fish.
 Platform Thinking 
 Identify patterns across teams and build shared components, templates, and frameworks that compound the org's automation leverage over time.
 Create reusable building blocks (prompt libraries, integration patterns, automation templates) that turn individual wins into org-wide capability.
 Partner with Engineering and IT on the platform decisions that make this leverage durable. 
 What success looks like: 
 Within your first 6-12 months, success in this role will look like:
 A portfolio of automations in production with documented business impact (hours saved, error rates reduced, cycle times shortened) across at least three different teams.
 A measurable lift in the number of non-technical colleagues confidently building their own automations, supported by templates, documentation, and coaching you've put in place.
 A reusable library of components, patterns, and templates that other builders, technical and non-technical, can pick up and apply.
 Recognition as the go-to partner across Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Customer Success for 'can this be automated?' and 'is this worth automating?' questions.
 A clear point of view on Later's automation roadmap: what the next high-leverage opportunities are, and where the platform investments need to land.

 A track record of building and shipping automations, internal tools, or AI-powered workflows that delivered measurable business impact.
 Strong fluency with modern AI tooling (LLMs, agents, RAG, prompt design) and comfort wiring together APIs, scripts, and no-code/low-code platforms.
 A business-first mindset: you start with the problem and the user, not the technology, and can sharpen a non-technical partner's problem definition through the right questions.
 Resourcefulness and a bias to action: you ship a working v1 in days, not months, and iterate from there.
 An instinct for scale, knowing when something is good enough as a one-off versus when it needs to be built to serve the whole org.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical audiences and coach others to build their own solutions.
 Experience in an internal-tools, RevOps, BizOps, or 'applied AI' function is a plus.
 A background in supporting or training non-technical builders (citizen developers, ops teams running their own tooling) is a bonus.
 Comfort with data: pulling it, cleaning it, and reasoning about it.

The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.



About the team:

At Wealthsimple, we aren't just managing portfolios; we're rewriting the rules of how Canadians interact with credit. The Credit Analytics team own’s Wealthsimple's lending ecosystem, operating at the intersection of high-growth tech and data-driven underwriting.



We believe that being “credit-worthy” should mean more than just a traditional score. Our mission is to challenge the status quo, building inclusive products that empower millions of Canadians and the businesses they run to lead better financial lives. We’re growing fast, moving from small data to massive scale through iteration and experimentation.



We are extending our consumer credit expertise into business lending built for Canadian small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). This is a true green-field build — new adjudication policy, new underwriting signals, and new risk infrastructure, informed by everything we've learned scaling our consumer card portfolio.



About the role:

We are looking for a Senior Associate to own credit policy for our business lending products, starting with a business credit card — from adjudication through the full account lifecycle. You will design and implement the underwriting framework that determines who qualifies and at what limit, build the line management strategies that govern how those limits evolve, and partner closely with collections to manage risk once accounts are on book.



Small business cards can be underwritten on the owner, or on the business as it grows. You’ll be working with cash flow, seasonality, industry, and business bureau data, which is usually thinner and messier than consumer bureau data. We need someone who has worked across that range and can turn it into automated policy instead of file-by-file decisions.



You will collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Fraud, and Client Experience to translate policy into shippable adjudication and monitoring systems, and you will have significant ownership over how this portfolio’s risk appetite is defined from day one.



In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

 - Build a new lending program from the ground up with the breadth to see every part of it, from policy to funding, and the runway to grow into leading a lending line of business.

 - Design and own the adjudication policy for a new business credit card, including entity-level underwriting criteria, principal/guarantor assessment, joint-liability, initial limit-setting, and approval decisioning.

 - Own line management strategy for business credit products: credit limit increases and decreases, pricing, authorization rules, and active exposure management driven by cash-flow and balance monitoring.

 - Partner with the collections team to design risk-managed treatment strategies specific to business accounts, and to build lifecycle monitoring that catches emerging risk early.

 - Evaluate the performance of the business lending portfolio and your policies, using vintage analysis, cohort tracking, and champion/challenger testing to validate and refine underwriting decisions.

 - Propose policy enhancements that improve marginal profitability while keeping risk within appetite, informed by rigorous root-cause analysis rather than surface-level metrics.

 - Help define the data and underwriting infrastructure needed for SMB lending — including how to source, validate, and weigh business financial data alongside traditional bureau signals.

 - Influence roadmaps across partner teams (Engineering, Product, Data Science, Fraud, and Client Experience) and implement policy that drives measurable impact.

We're looking for someone who:

 - Has direct experience underwriting or setting credit policy for small and medium-sized businesses, this is a must-have for this role. Card experience isn't required; we'd love to hear from you if your background is in instalment loans or lines of credit.

 - Writes SQL hands-on to self-serve data and build monitoring and analytics.

 - Brings credit discipline to a ship-and-iterate environment, and is comfortable shaping policy while the product itself is still being defined.

 - Can turn analysis into a clear recommendation for technical and non-technical audiences, weigh incomplete or noisy information and still reach well-grounded decisions.

 - Is intellectually curious, passionate about their work, and wants ownership over their projects.

Preferred qualifications:

 - 5+ years of experience in small business lending

 - Knowledge of Canadian consumer credit bureau data (Equifax, TransUnion)

 - Working knowledge of how business credit risk differs from consumer credit risk: entity vs. personal guarantor assessment, business bureau data (e.g., business credit bureaus), cash-flow-based underwriting, industry/sector risk, and revenue seasonality.

 - Experience across the credit lifecycle: adjudication policy, line management, pricing, and collections strategy.

 - Experience with statistical/quantitative analysis: experimental design, champion/challenger (or A/B) testing, model accuracy validation, constrained optimization, decision trees, discounted cash flows, financial modeling.

 - Experience with Python, and GitHub. Airflow, AWS Redshift, and dbt are a plus.

We're building for distributors, and we're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to be on the core team for this new go-to-market. This is not a role that inherits a launch calendar. You'll help decide who we build for, what problem we lead with, and how we talk about.

You'll work side by side with product, engineering, sales,  supplier success, and our distributor customers. The products, the positioning, and the go-to-market programs are all still being written, and you'll write a good part of them. Distributors run a different business than contractors, with branches, counter staff, outside sales, and margins measured in points. You'll learn that business well enough to talk shop at the counter and in the boardroom.

 - Get out to the branches and the main office. Run customer discovery with distributor owners, operations leaders, inside and outside sales, and counter staff, and bring what you hear back to Product.

 - Define the ideal customer and the buyer. Sort which distributors we serve first, by size, trade, and how they sell today.

 - Write the positioning and messaging for new distributor products from a blank page, in partner language. We make their counter easier and their contractor relationships stronger.

 - Shape pricing and packaging with leadership. Test it with early customers and refine it as the market answers.

 - Plan and run the first launches: beta and early-access programs, launch plans, and the story for each release.

 - Partner with sales on the first sales playbook, including the pitch, demo flow, objection handling, and discovery questions. Then enable the reps who carry it.

 - Turn early customers into proof. That means pilots with clear success measures, case studies, and the numbers distributors care about: orders handled, disputes avoided, and hours back at the counter.

 - Map the competitive field for distributor technology, including ERPs, ecommerce platforms, and homegrown tools, and show where we fit.

 - 5+ years in product marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or a technical product.

 - At least one product you helped take from zero to one: the early discovery, the first positioning, and the first paying customers. You should be able to say what you'd do differently.

 - A self-starter's drive, solid project management, and a bias for action.

 - Experience in wholesale distribution, electrical or plumbing supply, or construction is a strong plus.

About the company 
 Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.
 Project Highlights 
 Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
 Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
 Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
 No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
 All contributors are license-verified physicians
 $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved
 What this project involves 
 We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:
 Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
 Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
 Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.
 Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.
 What we look for 
 This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:
 Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
 Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
 Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
 Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
 Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
 Strong written English (C1+).
 This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.
 How it works 
 Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks
 Flexibility 
 You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.
 Earnings 
 Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.
 $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
 Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

About the company 
 Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.
 Project Highlights 
 Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
 Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
 Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
 No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
 All contributors are license-verified physicians
 $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved
 What this project involves 
 We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:
 Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
 Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
 Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.
 Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.
 What we look for 
 This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:
 Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
 Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
 Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
 Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
 Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
 Strong written English (C1+).
 This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.
 How it works 
 Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks
 Flexibility 
 You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.
 Earnings 
 Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.
 $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
 Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

 · Le soutien aux projets. Nous appuyons les responsables de projet avec le contrôle des coûts, les agents de projet, le contrôle documentaire, la formation et le suivi des risques. 
 · La transformation opérationnelle. Nous faisons évoluer nos processus, nos outils et nos mesures de performance, avec une gouvernance claire, pour améliorer en continu notre façon de gérer les projets. 
 Notre façon de travailler 
 Nous accompagnons chaque projet de bout en bout, de l'offre de service à la clôture. Nous croyons à l'intelligence collective et à la collaboration, avec les valeurs de Norda Stelo : confiance, excellence, intégrité, respect, innovation et adaptabilité. 
 Notre ambition 
 Être le partenaire privilégié de nos équipes de vente et de projet : des offres de service mieux préparées pour remporter des mandats rentables, et des projets mieux soutenus pour les livrer avec confiance. 
 Votre rôle : influencer, anticiper et faire évoluer

Votre capacité à analyser les résultats, anticiper les risques et formuler des recommandations éclairées contribuera directement à la qualité des décisions et à la performance financière de l'organisation. 
 Au-delà du suivi financier, vous aurez l'occasion de structurer, d'harmoniser et de faire évoluer les pratiques de contrôle des coûts à l'échelle de Norda Stelo. 
 Votre influence ne se limitera pas aux chiffres : elle contribuera à façonner nos façons de gérer et de piloter les projets. 
 Vos principaux mandats et responsabilités 
 Assurer une vision globale de la performance financière : consolider, analyser et interpréter les données financières de l'ensemble du portefeuille afin d'offrir une lecture claire de la santé des projets. 
 Anticiper les risques et les écarts : identifier les tendances, les dépassements potentiels et les enjeux financiers, évaluer leurs impacts et proposer des stratégies d'intervention. 
 Piloter les prévisions financières : superviser les suivis budgétaires, analyser les coûts engagés et les coûts à terminaison, et produire des prévisions consolidées fiables. 
 Conseiller les équipes de direction : accompagner les directeurs et responsables de projets dans l'analyse de leur performance financière et les soutenir dans leurs prises de décision. 
 Optimiser le contrôle des coûts : recommander des mesures correctives, évaluer les impacts financiers des changements de portée et contribuer à la maîtrise des budgets. 
 Faire évoluer les pratiques : développer, harmoniser et améliorer les outils, méthodes et processus de contrôle des coûts à l'échelle de l'organisation. 
 Garantir la qualité de l'information : effectuer des vérifications ciblées afin d'assurer l'exactitude, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données financières et des prévisions. 
 Partager votre expertise : agir comme personne-ressource auprès des équipes, favoriser le transfert de connaissances et contribuer au développement d'une culture de gestion axée sur la rigueur et la performance. 
 Votre profil 
 Baccalauréat ou DEC en finance, comptabilité, administration, ingénierie ou dans un domaine pertinent. 
 10 ans et plus d'expérience en contrôle des coûts, en contrôle de projets ou en analyse financière dans un environnement de projets. 
 Expérience significative dans un environnement d'ingénierie, de construction, industriel ou multidisciplinaire (un atout). 
 Excellente maîtrise du suivi budgétaire, de l'analyse des écarts, des prévisions financières et des estimations à terminaison. 
 Maîtrise avancée d'Excel et aisance avec les systèmes et outils de gestion de projets. 
 Fortes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et de vulgarisation de l'information financière. 
 Aptitude à influencer, conseiller et mobiliser des intervenants à différents niveaux de l'organisation. 
 Leadership, autonomie, rigueur et esprit d'amélioration continue. 
 Bilinguisme français et anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. 
 La connaissance de la langue anglaise est demandée, car le poste nécessite de transiger avec des clients et collègues anglophones des États-Unis/Ouest canadien. 
 Pourquoi choisir Norda Stelo? 
 Parce qu'ici, votre expertise peut avoir un impact bien au-delà de votre rôle! 
 Une influence à l'échelle de l'organisation : une vision transversale du portefeuille et la possibilité de faire évoluer les pratiques de gestion. 
 Une proximité avec les décideurs : un accès direct à la direction et une contribution concrète aux orientations du Bureau. 
 Une diversité de projets : des mandats stimulants dans les secteurs des mines, de l'énergie, des infrastructures et de l'industrie. 
 Un environnement propice à votre développement : formations, mentorat, plan de développement personnalisé et remboursement des formations et certifications admissibles, notamment le PMP. 
 Une carrière à long terme : un poste permanent au sein d'une firme en croissance qui valorise l'initiative et l'expertise. 
 Une culture sérieusement humaine : un milieu où la collaboration, la transparence, l'autonomie et la reconnaissance font partie de notre quotidien. 
 Depuis plus de 60 ans, Norda Stelo met son expertise en ingénierie au service de projets qui font une différence. Présente dans plus de 50 pays, notre firme est certifiée B Corp et figure parmi les Sociétés les mieux gérées au Canada depuis 2022. 
 Prêt(e) à donner une nouvelle dimension à votre expertise et à influencer la performance de projets d'envergure? 
 Suivez votre étoile et joignez-vous à une équipe où votre expertise compte, vos idées font avancer les choses et votre contribution génère de l'ingénierie d'impact!

 Norda Stelo souscrit au principe d’accès à l’égalité en emploi et encourage fortement les femmes, les personnes issues de la diversité culturelle, les personnes en situation de handicap, les personnes appartenant aux communautés LGBTQIA2+, les personnes autochtones et/ou les personnes appartenant à un groupe traditionnellement marginalisé à poser leur candidature.

 Futurpreneur est un organisme national à but non lucratif qui habilite les jeunes entrepreneur.e.s de divers horizons, âgé.e.s de 18 à 39 ans, à démarrer, acheter et développer leurs entreprises au Canada, en leur offrant des prêts avec du mentorat et des ressources.

 Futurpreneur est un membre fondateur de l’ Alliance des jeunes entrepreneur.e.s du G20 , le représentant canadien du réseau Youth Business International et l’hôte canadien de la Semaine mondiale de l’entrepreneuriat .
 Notre but (notre raison d’être) : favoriser la prospérité inclusive au Canada en soutenant le succès des jeunes entrepreneur.e.s.

 L’opportunité :

BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $169 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.



L'équipe Opérations de l'expérience client façonne, au quotidien, l'expérience que Wealthsimple offre à sa clientèle. Nous gérons les interactions concrètes, par courriel, par clavardage et par téléphone, ainsi que les moments charnières où une personne choisit de nous confier, ou non, sa vie financière. Notre objectif est simple : offrir un soutien rapide, fluide et fiable qui dépasse les attentes des personnes que nous servons.




 - Modèle 100 % télétravail : Ce poste est entièrement à distance. Vous pouvez travailler de n'importe où au Canada.

 - Environnement de travail : Bien que le poste soit à distance, les candidats doivent disposer d'un espace de travail privé, calme et professionnel, doté d'une connexion Internet haute vitesse fiable, afin de garantir la confidentialité et la qualité de nos interactions avec les clients.

 - Date de début visée : le 4 janvier, 2027.

 - Contrat : Engagement initial de 6 mois avec possibilité de prolongation et opportunités d'évolution en interne.



Wealthsimple connaît une croissance rapide, et chaque jour, de plus en plus de Canadiennes et de Canadiens commencent à utiliser notre plateforme. Cette croissance s'accompagne d'un effort tout aussi important pour que notre clientèle ait de moins en moins besoin de nous joindre. Nous nous attaquons aux causes profondes des problèmes courants et créons de meilleurs outils en libre-service, notamment grâce à l'IA, afin que la clientèle puisse régler les questions simples de façon autonome. Notre équipe peut ainsi se concentrer sur les conversations où l'intervention humaine fait toute la différence.






À PROPOS DU POSTE

Quand quelque chose ne fonctionne pas comme la cliente ou le client s'y attendait, c'est vous qui rectifiez le tir. Vous aiderez la clientèle par clavardage, au téléphone et par courriel, en prenant en charge des questions et des problèmes qui demandent une vraie réflexion, et non des réponses toutes faites. Certains jours, il s'agira de démêler une situation complexe; d'autres jours, de rassurer une personne et de l'accompagner étape par étape. C'est un travail exigeant et structuré, qui demande un bon jugement, de l'intelligence émotionnelle et le sens des responsabilités nécessaire pour mener chaque dossier à terme. Bien exercé, ce rôle est l'un des plus importants chez Wealthsimple.




CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

 - Aider la clientèle par clavardage, au téléphone et par courriel, en gérant un flux constant de conversations du début à la fin.

 - Accompagner la clientèle dans ce qui compte le plus pour elle, qu'il s'agisse de questions rapides ou de problèmes complexes liés à ses placements ou à ses services bancaires.

 - Écouter attentivement, vous mettre à la place de la clientèle et communiquer avec la clarté, la chaleur et la bienveillance auxquelles elle devrait s'attendre chaque fois qu'elle s'adresse à Wealthsimple.

 - Prendre en charge chaque dossier qui vous est confié : trouver la véritable source du problème, dénicher la réponse même face à une situation inédite et faire un suivi pour que rien ne passe entre les mailles du filet.

 - Travailler selon un horaire établi et atteindre des cibles claires en matière de qualité, de productivité et de respect de l'horaire. Ces cibles sont au cœur de l'évaluation du rendement dans ce poste.

 - Acquérir une connaissance approfondie des produits de Wealthsimple et des notions financières sur lesquelles ils reposent, et continuer d'apprendre au fil de leur évolution.

 - Tirer parti du coaching et de la rétroaction sur la qualité pour perfectionner constamment votre savoir-faire.




VOS DÉBUTS:

 - Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, avec une communication écrite et orale claire et chaleureuse dans les deux langues (exigence essentielle).

 - Expérience en service à la clientèle, que ce soit en technologie, en hôtellerie et restauration, dans le commerce de détail, dans les services financiers ou dans un autre domaine.

 - Bon jugement et capacité à prendre rapidement de bonnes décisions, même quand la réponse n'est pas évidente.

 - Grande intelligence émotionnelle, notamment la capacité à bien cerner les gens et à garder son sang-froid dans les situations tendues.

 - Débrouillardise et détermination pour trouver des réponses par vous-même.

 - Vitesse et précision au clavier, et agilité pour passer rapidement d'un outil ou d'un système à l'autre sans perdre de vue la clientèle.

 - Aisance à travailler selon un horaire établi et avec des cibles mesurables.




ATOUTS

 - De 1 à 2 ans d'expérience dans les services financiers




QUI VOUS ÊTES

Vous prenez les choses en main. Quand une cliente ou un client vous soumet un problème, ce problème devient le vôtre jusqu'à ce qu'il soit réglé. Vous ne le refilez pas à quelqu'un d'autre en espérant que tout se passe bien. La curiosité vous pousse à comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent, et vous faites preuve de débrouillardise quand la réponse ne saute pas aux yeux. Vous avez à cœur les personnes que vous aidez, et cela se voit : vous sentez quand une personne s'inquiète pour son argent, et vous savez ramener le calme dans la conversation. Enfin, vous avez la détermination nécessaire pour bien faire ce travail jour après jour, même quand la file d'attente déborde et que les problèmes sont difficiles.

Nul besoin d'une formation en finance. Les personnes qui viennent de la technologie, de l'hôtellerie et de la restauration ou du commerce de détail possèdent souvent exactement les compétences que ce poste exige. Ce qui compte le plus, c'est la curiosité, la débrouillardise, l'habitude de résoudre les problèmes par soi-même et un réel souci de la clientèle.




VOS DÉBUTS

Vous apprendrez ce que vous devez savoir une fois parmi nous. Notre programme d'intégration est conçu pour que toute personne ayant les bonnes compétences puisse réussir, peu importe son parcours.

Vous commencerez par une formation sur Wealthsimple : nos produits, notre clientèle, ainsi que les principes et les normes qui guident notre façon de la servir. Vous aurez un aperçu de tout ce que nous faisons. Vous mettrez ensuite ces apprentissages en pratique en aidant la clientèle dans un contexte réel et encadré, le temps de prendre de l'assurance. Quand le moment sera venu, vous intégrerez un secteur précis de notre équipe de soutien pour vous spécialiser, approfondir vos connaissances et développer une expertise dans un volet de nos activités.

Des possibilités d'avancement existent au-delà de ce poste, et certaines personnes accèdent à d'autres rôles chez Wealthsimple. Ce n'est toutefois pas automatique : cela se mérite en faisant bien ce travail et en prenant en main votre propre développement.




VOS AVANTAGES CHEZ WEALTHSIMPLE :

 - Compte de dépenses santé (CDS) : 3 000 $/an Un compte flexible, financé par Wealthsimple, pour couvrir vos frais de santé, soins dentaires, optiques et plus encore.

 - Régime d’épargne collectif Wealthsimple verse une cotisation automatique de 3 % et égale vos propres contributions jusqu’à 1,5 % (pour une contribution totale de l’entreprise allant jusqu’à 4,5 %).

Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Finance at Brex 
 The Finance team is a strategic engine at Brex. We lead planning, forecasting, capital allocation, and ROI analysis — partnering across the business to drive clarity and unlock opportunity. We partner across teams at Brex to ensure our business is building and planning with the same dream big goals throughout our entire organization. We’re not here to report on outcomes; we shape them. If you want to influence company direction and think long-term about value creation, this is where your ownership starts. 
 Cross-functional alignment: We work on complex problems that cut across Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, CX, and more. This requires the ability to generate buy-in from a wide set of stakeholders on key initiatives
 Business intelligence: We are a data-driven organization that always provides data to support our decision-making. When data is not available, we find it in market and competitive research. We convey complex financial information to varied stakeholders in order to influence decisions.
 Problem solving: We lead with solutions by defining an ambiguous problem, processing information, applying judgment and creativity, and generating buy-in around the answer. This requires the ability to not only track and improve key metrics, but to define what those key metrics should be.
 Building, not just advising: We ship the models, tooling, and automation that the frameworks depend on, and we own their accuracy.
 Where you’ll work 
 This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!
 What You’ll Do 
 We are building out the Strategic Finance team and looking for someone to join the function and partner with leadership to maximize ROI from our investments.
 In this role, you will own the frameworks Brex uses to underwrite and measure return on investment across the business. You will translate roadmap proposals, GTM investments, headcount requests, and pricing changes into expected return, payback, and opportunity cost, so that business partners and Finance underwrite decisions off the same set of numbers. You will work with leaders across the company, and you will close the loop after the fact, measuring realized return against what was originally underwritten.
 You will bring both the financial and the commercial point of view, and need to embrace challenges and structure complex problems. This role carries high exposure to Executive Leadership, as you will regularly deliver analysis and recommendations directly to the Leadership team.
 Responsibilities 
 Build and own the frameworks used to evaluate investment decisions across the business, spanning R&D, GTM, headcount, and pricing
 Partner with business leaders on capital allocation: sizing the cost of a given bet, pricing the tradeoffs between competing uses of the next dollar, and framing opportunity cost in terms leadership can act on
 Develop the unit economics and ROI measurement standards applied to new product launches, pricing changes, GTM programs, and platform investments
 Run post-investment measurement on major bets, comparing realized return to what was underwritten and feeding those learnings back into the framework
 Quantify the downstream commercial impact of product and GTM decisions on revenue, margin, and customer lifetime value
 Translate operating and capacity inputs into financial impact, and financial constraints into terms business partners can plan against
 Build shared definitions and a single source of truth across Finance, EPD, GTM, and Revenue Operations so all organizations plan off the same numbers
 Ship the models, dashboards, and automation the frameworks depend on, and own their accuracy
 Provide ad hoc analytical support to GTM Finance and Revenue Operations on pipeline, conversion, retention, expansion, and go-to-market efficiency questions
 Requirements 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or related field
 2+ years of Strategic Finance, FP&A, or Investment Banking experience
 An AI-first mindset: you default to asking how AI can improve every workflow, you actively experiment with new tools, and you have used AI to accelerate analysis or automate a task
 Mastery of Excel and PowerPoint with proven experience in building financial models and managing complex data 
 Strong communication, team-working, quantitative and analytical skills
 Intellectual curiosity, a collaborative work style, and the drive to take ownership in a fast-moving environment
 Comfort managing multiple workstreams simultaneously and proactively driving work forward without being asked
 A bias toward proactive insight over reactive reporting
 Ability to operate independently, build structure in ambiguous environments, and prioritize effectively
 Comfort working directly in data: SQL or BI tooling experience is a strong plus (Snowflake, Hex, Looker, or Salesforce)
 Compensation 
 The expected salary range for this role is $104,000-$130,000 CAD however, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


ROLE OVERVIEW:

We're growing our Canadian Public Sector Delivery team and hiring Public Sector Delivery Analysts to help run some of the most consequential AI deployments in the country. You'll work alongside our Engineering Program Managers (EPMs), Technical Leads, and senior leadership to keep large, multi-stakeholder government programs organized, documented, and moving.

This is a hands-on delivery role for individuals who want exposure to enterprise AI and high-stakes program delivery while taking pride in making complex programs run smoothly. As a member of our small, senior team, you'll deliver sovereign AI to the Government of Canada, engage directly with clients from day one on a clear path toward leading engagements, and learn how frontier AI products are deployed in real, high-security environments.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Drive things to closure. Partner with the EPM and Technical Leads to track actions, dependencies, and blockers across Cohere and client teams making sure nothing slips.

 - Show up in front of the client. Prepare and coordinate client sessions, capture outcomes, and progressively lead working-level sessions such as use-case and story refinement.

 - Run the cadence. Own the meeting and reporting rhythm including agendas, scheduling, minutes, and follow-ups so every forum lands on time with clear next steps.

 - Own the delivery artefacts. Build and maintain the plans, status reports, RAID logs, decision records, use-case registers, and traceability documentation that keep our engagements audit-ready and our clients confident.

 - Keep the record straight. Maintain a single source of truth for program documentation in our public sector document management environment.

 - 1–4 years of experience in technology or management consulting, professional services, or an in-house technical delivery team.

 - Delivery discipline. You've run RAID, action, and decision logs, refined user stories, maintained project plans on real projects and kept them accurate and clear.

 - Client presence. You can lead a working session in front of a client, read the room, and know what to say and what to hold.

 - Strong written communication. You think through the message before you build the slide. Advanced PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.

 - Technical fluency. You're comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, environments, testing, and releases. You can talk with engineers and report back accurately.

 - Follow-through. You close items without a second reminder and know what to escalate and when.

 - Eligibility for a Government of Canada security clearance.

 - Based in the Ottawa area.

 - University Degree in Business/Commerce, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar preferred.

 - Nice-to-have: High degree of French language proficiency.

This role is hybrid with the requirement to be based out of Ottawa - note, there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement.

This role requires eligibility for a Government of Canada security clearance and a high degree of French language proficiency is a nice-to-have.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

ABOUT US 
 At xMentium, we help enterprises turn their unstructured language and documents into structured, usable data at scale. Our AI-powered platform, anchored by xTract, transforms sprawling repositories of contracts, licenses, technical documentation, communications, and other business-critical documents into clean, queryable metadata that powers analytics, agents, and downstream systems.
 We work across industries, including media and entertainment, oil and gas, manufacturing, real estate, financial services, and enterprise AI transformation more broadly, helping customers ground their AI agents, accelerate due diligence, unlock the value trapped in legacy repositories, and finally make their documents work for them.
 We understand that life is about more than just work and believe that driving to a headquarters is part of the problem. That's why we're a remote-first company and offer flexible work arrangements that empower you to balance your professional and personal life effectively. Your well-being is important to us, and we encourage a healthy work-life balance to ensure you have time for what matters most to you and can always do what you need to do.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We're looking for a Solution Architect to lead and own the end-to-end technical delivery of customer solutions, spanning both pre-sales and post-sales, from early discovery through implementation and deployment. This is not a technical support, traditional sales engineering, or project management role. It is a hands-on, customer-facing architecture and development role responsible for turning business objectives into practical, secure, and scalable solutions using xMentium's Document Intelligence platform.
 As part of the Solutions Delivery team, you will take technical ownership of customer engagements across the entire solution lifecycle, ensuring continuity from pre-sales discovery and solution design through proofs of concept, integrations, implementation, and production deployment. You will not simply advise on architecture or hand off designs to others. You will lead the technical work required to bring solutions to life, developing a comprehensive understanding of each customer's environment, making sound architecture decisions, and driving solutions through to successful delivery.
 You will serve as the primary technical owner and trusted partner for customers, working closely with Sales, Engineering, and System Integrators. You will lead customer architecture conversations independently, involving senior technical leaders where their expertise or authority adds value. In coordination with project management, you will help drive technical decisions, identify dependencies and risks, and keep solutions coherent.
 Responsibilities
 Own customer solution design and delivery from pre-sales discovery through implementation, deployment, and transition to ongoing operations.
 Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer objectives, document and data landscapes, existing architecture, constraints, security requirements, and success criteria.
 Design and prototype solutions using xMentium’s platform and integrating with customer environments, including tools such as SharePoint, Fabric, Databricks, OpenText, and other solution platforms.
 Develop document processing automations using TypeScript and the xMentium platform tools.
 Lead discussions about cloud, customer-tenant, and on-premises deployment models, including networking, identity, permissions, data residency, scalability, reliability, supportability, and operational ownership.
 Address security, privacy, and compliance topics credibly, working with internal specialists where formal review or deeper expertise is required.
 Present solution options and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including customer architects, security teams, business leaders, and implementation teams.
 Partner with Sales to qualify technical fit, surface delivery complexity and risk, establish realistic expectations, and shape technically sound proposals and statements of work.
 Partner with Product and Engineering to validate product fit, identify gaps, and distinguish reusable product capabilities from customer-specific delivery work.
 Capture reusable patterns, reference architectures, lessons learned, and technical guidance that improve future customer engagements.
 7+ years of experience in solutions architecture, enterprise architecture, consulting, software engineering, technical delivery, or a comparable customer-facing technical role.
 Demonstrated experience owning complex customer solutions across both pre-sales and post-sales stages.
 Full stack software development experience with TypeScript.
 Strong understanding of modern application, integration, data, and cloud architecture, including APIs, event-driven patterns, databases, identity, networking, and deployment practices.
 Experience designing integrations across enterprise platforms and working through varied APIs, authentication models, permissions, and real-world data constraints.
 Working knowledge of Microsoft ecosystem; experience with Microsoft Fabric is strongly valued.
 Practical knowledge of enterprise security and compliance concerns, including identity and access management, data protection, encryption, auditability, privacy, and data residency.
 Ability to lead discovery and architecture discussions independently, ask incisive questions, and turn incomplete information into a clear path forward.
 Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions in plain language and build trust with both executives and practitioners.
 Sound technical judgment and a pragmatic approach to balancing customer value, product capability, risk, timeline, scope, and long-term maintainability.
 Comfort operating across organizational boundaries.
